profile.headline: A Principal Software Engineer at Roche working on the long-term vision of a new generation of gene sequencing systems capable of high throughput, fast turnaround, and low cost realized through accelerated edge computing.
profile.summary: C++ / CUDA software engineer developing accelerated analysis pipelines to push the whole field of gene sequencing to higher throughput and faster turnaround.

positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Languages / platforms: C++, CUDA / TensorRT, Python, Linux, DPDK.
• Developing an accelerated nanopore genetic sequencing analysis pipeline running on NVIDIA H100 NVLs, capable of real-time generation of billions of demultiplexed reads per hour.
• Developing a secondary analysis pipeline in partnership with NVIDIA Parabricks, capable of real-time mapping and alignment to enable record-breaking turnaround time.
• Coordinating with several other teams on the testing, analysis, and requirements management of an integrated sequencing workflow.
• Supporting R&D on the development of new sequencing applications with analysis workflows on an on-prem cluster of GPU-accelerated nodes.
• Supporting program-critical compute hardware decisions and deployments, including at early access collaboration sites.

• Supported implementation of the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS™ Title for Fastest DNA Sequencing Technique at the Broad Clinical Labs.

https://broadclinicallabs.org/broad-clinical-labs-sets-new-guinness-world-records-title-for-fastest-dna-sequencing-technique/

https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2512825?query=featured_home

positions.title: Senior GPU Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: System Performance · Python (Programming Language) · Nanopore Sequencing · Graphics Processing Unit · Computer Hardware · Linux Kernel · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Network Engineering · Linux · CUDA · C++ · HP Server Hardware · Deep Learning

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Languages/libraries/platforms: Java (Spring), Python (numpy, pillow, opencv, seaborn, python-pptx), C#, CI (git, bamboo), Jira.
• Determined CODEX analysis workflow for spatially registered multiplex fluorescence microscopy data.
• Optimized GPU-accelerated pipeline for 1) image registration, 2) deconvolution, 3) shading correction, 4) auto-fluorescence subtraction and 5) segmentation.
• Developed U-Net deep learning segmentation algorithm and evaluation metrics.
• Assisted business operations with IT administration including G Suite, Office 365, Azure, AWS, and Atlassian.
positions.insights: Skills: System Performance · Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis · Computer Science · Java · Graphics Processing Unit · Deconvolution · Computer Hardware · Data Structures · Data Engineering · Communication · Debugging · Git · Image Registration · Biomedical Engineering · Image Segmentation · Deep Learning · Software Design · Performance Analysis

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Languages/libraries/platforms: C++, Qt/QML, CUDA, DCMTK, C#, Python, Perforce, Jira.
• Developed clinical ultrasound scanner software.
• Developed radiology reader software and on-workstation image post-processing.
• Analyzed data for computer-assisted diagnosis algorithms targeting breast cancer detection.
• Investigated and addressed field issues regarding ultrasound image quality.
• Automated GUI and mechanical tests using Squish.
• Led software verification and provided backroom support for FDA and TUV audits.
• Led reliability improvement projects for ultrasound transducers and probe cables.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
• Languages/libraries/platforms: Matlab, Python.
• Developed ultrasound transmit and receive scan sequences for optimal thermoacoustic imaging.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Data Structures · Communication · Biomedical Engineering

positions.title: Research Specialist
positions.description:
• Languages/libraries/platforms: Matlab, Verilog, SolidWorks.
• Developed a reader study software for breast cancer diagnosis using ultrasound, x-ray and image registration.
• Built a therapeutic ultrasound system with a 298-channel, 1.50-MHz phased array, including its FPGA firmware, control software and electrical design.
• Developed a control system for ultrasound, photoacoustic and x-ray tomography imaging systems.

positions.title: Assistant Researcher
positions.description:
• Languages/libraries/platforms: C.
• Improved algorithms for tracking and segmenting coronary arterial images that helped detect arterial stenosis and calcification.
